description: Default capability for the main Bridge window, every floating companion overlay window, and every click-through annotate window. Deliberately minimal: core only — the sensor_bridge commands are gated behind explicit user permission grants (deny OS permissions → Bridge still fully useful, per the graceful-degradation rule). `annotate*` must be listed: the annotation surface receives its typed marks over a core event, and `plugin:event|listen` is a CORE command, so without a capability entry the webview is denied permission to listen and silently never renders a mark (custom #[tauri::command]s still work, which is what made this fail invisibly).
